title: Fast Tracking with SPADs from Binary 1-Bit Per Pixel Output: Single-Photon Single-Particle Tracking
content: Biological particles, ranging from biomolecules to viral capsids, exhibit diffusion rates often exceeding 1 µm²/s. Such rapid motion introduces pronounced blurring artifacts when captured with conventional integrative detectors (e.g., sCMOS or EMCCD), often making individual particles appear as multiple particles. Single-photon detector arrays show promise toward mitigating blurring by providing up to a tenfold increase in temporal resolution. However, data from these arrays—offering only a binary (photon detected or not) signal per pixel—do not fit into the current tracking paradigm relying on intensity-based localization.
